summary: Twelve days to Expo (Nov 4). The duplicates fix (TW-103) and retry queue (TW-104) are live, and the error alert is on. The Harbor QBR went well, with follow-ups logged. The slot picker build (PR #241) waits on design review. Pricing numbers and the Pinecrest demo (Monday) remain open.

items.text: Retry queue TW-104 is live in production and the duplicates root-cause fix TW-103 has shipped. Arjun approved PR #238 (TW-137 done).
Error-rate alert TW-105, which pages on-call when sync errors exceed 1%, is live.
Ridgeline (22% of revenue, health yellow, renews Nov 20) had a third incident this quarter, with its CFO copied. The root-cause fix has now shipped. Renewal prep TW-113 is due Nov 13.
Harbor QBR is done and Dana's team liked the export fix and time zone display. Maya shared the renewal terms at the QBR (TW-136 done). Harbor renews Oct 30.
Dana wants written notes from the QBR. TW-139 is owned by Jordan, due today, todo.
Dana asked for a 4-week dock trend in Harbor's weekly report. TW-140 is owned by Sam, 3h, no due date.
Harbor's ops lead wants the same sync alerts Tidewell gets, sent to their ops channel. TW-142 is owned by Nina, 2h, no due date.
Slot picker build PR #241 is up but cannot merge until Sam completes the design review (TW-141, 1h). TW-117 is due Oct 29.
Expo demo screen 3 (TW-119, due Oct 30) still waits for the slot picker build, now available as PR #241 pending review.
Booth demo dry run took 2:40. Sam said it should be under 2 minutes. Jordan expects visitors to ask about pricing first.
Pricing page TW-125 waits on final pricing numbers, which Maya promised by Friday (today). The booth one-pager must show the same numbers as the pricing page.
The booth tablet flow uses the real slot picker, which Leila said must be stable by next Wednesday. TW-117 and TW-135 (empty/error states) are both due Oct 29.
Maya's October investor update TW-111 was due today and is still in progress. She says she is sending it today.
Expo invites go out today. Jordan has 40 leads at booth 412. TW-122 is in progress, due Oct 28.
Valley's data is flowing and its Smart Slots setup starts Monday. Coastal is live in staging. TW-121 is due Oct 30.
Pinecrest live demo is Monday. It is the third design partner needed, since only two are signed. TW-126 is due Oct 30.
Scoring API TW-115 (due Oct 28) has ranking wired in and load testing is next. Partner API docs TW-127 (due Oct 26) are in progress.
Nina has two Smart Slots tasks: TW-138, tuning ranking for Coastal's early-morning docks (in progress, due Oct 28), and new TW-143, a 10x-traffic load test (4h, due Oct 30).
Nina is on call this week and Arjun takes over the week of Oct 26. Arjun's second backend interview is at 3pm today (TW-110).
